title: Telemetry fabric and metric normalization for inference KPIs
creator: Marcus Liang
description: Implement a telemetry 'fabric' that ingests Prometheus and OTel metrics for inference workloads, applies normalization/enrichment for custom KPIs (p50/p95 latency per model, tokenized cost, cache hit ratio), and exports to our Grafana/SLO pipelines. Goals: unify label/tag schema across runtimes, perform deterministic sampling to reduce cardinality, add enrichment for model variant and routing policy, and provide a low-latency export path to SLI computation service.
acceptance_criteria: All inference-serving metrics ingested via OTel Collector with a shared label schema (service, model_name, model_variant, region, deployment_tier)
Prometheus exporters emit pre-aggregated token-level counters compatible with downstream cost calculators
Cardinality reduction implemented (route->route_hash) with sample rate control and deterministic sampling configs
Enrichment job joins request traces to metrics to compute per-model cache hit ratio and KV cache miss rate within 30s
Grafana dashboard 'Inference — Latency & Cost by Model' populated and SLO alerts wired to pager duty
End-to-end pipeline tested with synthetic traffic and load-tested to 10k rps with <5% time-series backlog
comments: 2025-11-09 - Kickoff: scoped telemetry fabric after meeting with Runtime team. Decided to use OTel Collector as the central aggregation point; will run sidecar in Dedicated nodes and as a daemonset in Private clusters. Action: prototype normalization rules.

2025-11-14 - Design review (PM + Runtime): PM raised requirement to preserve model version pin metadata. Added model_version label to schema. Runtime requested sampling hooks to avoid increased latency on hot paths.

2025-11-22 - Engineering spike complete: validated Prometheus export from runtime with pre-aggregated token counter; discovered 3 labels that caused cardinality explosion (instance_id, request_id, worker_id). Plan: drop instance/worker_id and replace request_id with request_hash.

2025-11-29 - PR opened: GH PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1345 implements collector config + normalization filters. RO review requested from @alice-ng and @dmitri. CI failing on instrumentation tests — investigating flakiness.

2025-12-01 - Performance run: synthetic 6k rps test shows 12% CPU overhead from enrichment join; optimized by batching trace->metric joins and caching model metadata. Re-ran tests, overhead down to 4%.
2025-12-02 - PM sign-off on schema; preparing rollout plan (canary on staging cluster -> dedicated pool -> global). Need console dashboard PR and Alerting runbook before canary.
